# sshdol

> Easy dict-like access to server files


## Pages in this subsection

- [sshdol](sshdol.html.md): SSH-based file access with Mapping interface.
- [sshdol.base](sshdol.base.html.md): Base functionality for sshdol.
- [sshdol.ops](sshdol.ops.html.md): Key-taking and scope-wide operations, as free functions over the caller’s (possibly wrapped) store.
